bug_exposed.issue: APPLICATION BUG (B-13 fix incomplete). trial_balance() at /app/backend/routes/rahaza_fin_reports.py line 37 fetches accounts with filter {"active": True}, so inactive accounts with balances are dropped from rows while balance-sheet & profit-loss include them. Result: totals.end_debit=79_597_700 vs end_credit=80_552_200 (diff −954_500) and response 'balanced': false. Same root cause as B-13 (inactive 1-1301-CUST-0005 restored as nonaktif per iter123 recovery). Also the frontend UI shows 'Ending Credit (UNBALANCED!)' banner on the Trial Balance tab — user-visible.
bug_exposed.secondary_issue: API inconsistency: trial-balance accepts `from`/`to` query params (not `as_of` like balance-sheet & P/L). Passing `as_of=2026-12-31` is silently ignored → defaults to today. Request spec asked for `as_of` support.
bug_exposed.why_iter123_missed_it: iter123 test_12_quick_regression_gl_balanced reads `total_debit`/`total_credit` at top level AND falls back to `totals.debit/credit`. Current schema returns nested `totals.end_debit/end_credit`, so all lookups return None and the assertion `if td is not None and tc is not None` skipped — the check silently became a no-op.
bug_exposed.priority: HIGH — Trial Balance is the primary user-facing double-entry proof; it currently prints an UNBALANCED alert in the UI even though ledger is actually consistent (balance-sheet balanced, 0 unbalanced JE).

infra_finding.issue: Frontend was stuck at 'Preparing preview…' when this iteration started. static_server.js self-heal auto-build failed with `Module not found: Error: Can't resolve '@simplewebauthn/browser' in '/app/frontend/src/pages'` even though the package is present in package.json (13.3.0) and installed under node_modules. A single manual `rm .autobuild.lock && yarn build` succeeded in ~21s (bundle produced). Likely a transient watcher/OOM issue on the first build after pod wake — worth adding a retry-with-cleared-node_modules-cache in the auto-build guard.
infra_finding.impact: If user hits the preview URL on a fresh pod wake, they may see 'Preparing preview…' indefinitely.
infra_finding.action_for_main_agent: Consider hardening static_server.js auto-build: on 'Cannot find ESLint plugin' or 'Module not found', clear .autobuild.lock and retry with `yarn install` first; or ship a prebuilt bundle.

rca_of_the_issue: During iter123, B-13 (L/R must include nonaktif) was patched in profit_loss() and balance_sheet() but the trial_balance() function retained its `active: True` account filter. Because iter123's regression assertion read TB fields that no longer exist in the response schema, the assertion silently became a no-op and never surfaced the residual imbalance. Repro: (1) any coa account with posted JE lines & active=False → will be excluded from TB rows while its counterpart JE lines on other (active) accounts remain, breaking Dr=Cr. Mitigation: change rahaza_fin_reports.py L37 to fetch all leaf accounts and apply the same `not active and no-movement → skip` rule as balance_sheet L367.
